thread:
maria-g: Heads up — Acme Labs confirmed external pen test window next Wed. Need to lock scope, RBAC, and evidence handoff.

josh-k: added. link to intake sheet: https://drive.example.com/pen-test-intake (editable by sec team)

maria-g: Scope draft posted in the doc: KMS console, key usage logs, infra control plane, private clusters, and admin consoles. Also ask for ephemeral creds only.

lia-ao: Quick question on logs: do assessors need full raw audit logs or just filtered events and alerts? retention concerns if we export everything.

maria-g: We need 30d of raw audit logs for KMS admin events + correlated network flow around any flagged alerts. But we can redact key material and sensitive fields before handing off.

sec-bot: PenTest Intake created (PT-2026). Assigned: @maria-g, @josh-k, @lia-ao. Reminder: include KMS audit export and presigned evidence bucket.

josh-k: For RBAC I'm proposing a temporary role "pen-test-assessor" with readonly to KMS metadata, CloudAudit logs, and compute describe. Limited to STS sessions for 6h. Sketch IAM policy below:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:DescribeKey","kms:ListKeys","cloudaudit.logs:Read","compute.instances.get"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

josh-k: We'll gate any write/delete ops. No key material export allowed.

lia-ao: KMS detail: will we log key usage context (keyId, requester) or just aggregated counts? Key IDs might be sensitive.

maria-g: Send key metadata (key IDs, not material) and requestor identities. Do not include plaintext key material or decrypted payloads. Ops, can we put an audit-proxy that scrubs secrets?

ops-bot: Actionable: enable KMS Admin audit logs to centralized bucket and start export job to presigned S3 with 7-day presigned URLs. Created ticket OPS-889.

josh-k: For remediation/tracking I suggest a Jira board: columns = intake, triage, fix-assigned, fix-ready, retest-requested, retest-verified. Add PT tag and webhook to update Slack channel.

maria-g: Agree. Also need runbooks for evidence packaging and ephemeral creds handoff. I'll draft onboarding notes for assessors: what we provide, what we redact, contact window.

lia-ao: Assessor ask: 48h notice before retest. Also they want a 2-hour dry-run to validate access and log visibility.

sec-bot: Reminder: rotate ephemeral roles after retest completion.

josh-k: I'll create the IAM role + onboarding doc. ETA: EOD Monday. @ops-bot can you confirm KMS logs export and presigned bucket by then?

ops-bot: Confirmed: bucket created (s3://pt-evidence-2423), export pipeline enabled, presigned link TTL set to 7 days. Access logs enabled.

maria-g: Great. Lia, can you scope redaction rules and coordinate with infra?

lia-ao: On it. Drafting redaction rules now: remove plaintext key material, remove full principal ARNs for service accounts (keep human IDs), mask IPs except /24. Will post in the intake doc.

maria-g: Assigning tasks: josh -> IAM role & onboarding; lia -> logging/export redaction; ops -> confirm exports & presigned bucket; I'll schedule vendor dry-run and invite assessors.

josh-k: Noted. Will add step-by-step for creating STS sessions and the ephemeral credentials rotation play.

maria-g: Can we also provide one-time presigned VM snapshot for forensic if they request? Might need legal signoff.

lia-ao: That escalates to legal/compliance. I'll ping compliance for guidance on snapshot sharing and PII.

sec-bot: PT-2026 updated: evidence bucket s3://pt-evidence-2423 created, OPS-889 linked, Jira board PT-2026-JIRA created.

maria-g: Thanks — scheduling 30m dry-run next Tue 10:00am. Please block calendar if you can join.

josh-k: I'll join. :thumbsup:

lia-ao: I'll be there. I'll bring the redaction checklist.

maria-g: I'll invite vendor and document the dry-run steps in the intake doc. After dry-run we confirm retest lead time and finalize the RBAC policy.

sec-bot: Note: After retest signoff, rotate all assessor STS roles and revoke presigned links.

maria-g: Closing loop: thanks everyone. Let's aim to have all artifacts ready 48h before test window.
